rows.name: ai-legal-claude
rows.oneLiner: Claude Code contract-review prompt and agent bundle with PDF-report scripts, but no ontology, knowledge-graph schema, or patent dataset.

rows.name: awesome-legal-data
rows.oneLiner: A single curated README of legal datasets, corpora, portals, benchmarks, and tools organized mostly by jurisdiction, with no bundled dataset.

rows.name: CapturingLegalReasoningPaths
rows.oneLiner: Japanese court-judgment reasoning-path assets comprising a lightweight JSON-LD legal-KG ontology, bilingual extraction prompts, and an annotated spreadsheet.

rows.name: cjeu-ontology-mappings
rows.oneLiner: A spreadsheet coverage study mapping selected CJEU case-law properties to ELI, CDM, LAKI, MetaLex, LKIF, and Oikeus.

rows.name: CommonCoreOntologies
rows.oneLiner: A BFO-aligned suite of eleven generic mid-level OWL ontologies with modular and merged releases, documentation, and release tooling.

rows.name: DAOnt
rows.oneLiner: An EU Data Act ontology integrating LKIF-Core, ODRL, and DPV with contract examples and SPARQL-driven compliance-checking code.

rows.name: GLEIO
rows.oneLiner: An RDF/OWL vocabulary for current and historical Legal Entity Identifier reference data, accompanied by a JSON schema and white paper.

rows.name: knowledge_graph
rows.oneLiner: A proof of concept that regex-extracts violators, violations, actions, fines, and dates from SEC litigation releases into tabular and nested graph outputs.

rows.name: Legal-Ontologies
rows.oneLiner: A curated README of legal ontology and knowledge-graph resources, datasets, development tools, and tutorials, without bundled ontology artifacts.

rows.name: Legal-Ontology-Learning
rows.oneLiner: A Python legal-domain ontology-learning experiment pipeline covering preprocessing, topic modeling, word and topic clustering, and cluster evaluation.

rows.name: legal-ontology-population
rows.oneLiner: A single OWL mapping artifact between LKIF and YAGO created for MIREL legal ontology population.

rows.name: LegalCaseKnowledgeGraph
rows.oneLiner: A Chinese legal-case dataset pairing narrative case facts with hand-structured subject-relation-object triples; it is not a FOPNet repository.

rows.name: LegalDatasets
rows.oneLiner: A DVC-backed collection of legal-data scrapers and dataset preparation lanes built around a normalized multilingual legal-document JSONL schema.

rows.name: LegalPapers
rows.oneLiner: A README-only bibliography of legal-intelligence datasets and papers across prediction, extraction, retrieval, summarization, and question answering.

rows.name: LegalPP
rows.oneLiner: Code and a packaged LegalLPP dataset for text-guided legal-provision prediction framed as knowledge-graph completion with BERT embeddings and R-GCN or GAT encoders.

rows.name: lkif-core
rows.oneLiner: The fifteen-module LKIF-Core legal ontology library in OWL and Turtle, already vendored, verified, and assessed in the wave-1 legal-ontology-landscape packet.

rows.name: llm4oe-slr
rows.oneLiner: Reproducible systematic-review tables covering 36 papers and 49 studies of LLM-supported ontology-engineering tasks, methods, evaluations, and datasets.

rows.name: O3POntology
rows.oneLiner: A BFO-aligned OWL 2 DL domain ontology for offshore petroleum-production plants, not legal or patent knowledge.

rows.name: patentlego-ontology
rows.oneLiner: A prose v0.1 functional patent-block vocabulary defining typed inputs and outputs, purpose categories, energy roles, scale, domain, connection points, and system templates.

rows.name: patentprocess-ontology
rows.oneLiner: A skeletal Clojure project template whose README remains boilerplate and whose shallow tree exposes no ontology artifact or implementation source.

rows.name: raglex
rows.oneLiner: A multi-jurisdiction legal-corpus harvester and hybrid search system with content-addressed raw storage, document versions, citation resolution, graph expansion, adapters, and a PostgreSQL schema.

rows.name: Semantic-Text-Similarity-STS-with-functional-semantic-knowledge-FOP-in-patents
rows.oneLiner: The FOPNet-priority implementation: Function-Object-Property patent triples, sample patent and IPC data, weighted semantic-similarity algorithms, and MAP, MRR, NDCG, and recall evaluation code; absent license evidence prevents extraction.

rows.name: semanticlaw
rows.oneLiner: Swiss-law RDF vocabularies and example statute graphs with a Python collector that represents legal texts as RDF.

rows.name: USPTO_ClassOntology
rows.oneLiner: Python scripts and RAR archives for collecting USPTO class definitions and comparing them with patent claims; the repository LICENSE file is empty.
